title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the amendment fee owed on each chargeable amendment
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product each chargeable amendment is settled by one amendment-fee row on the acceptance's account. While the account holds fewer amendment-fee rows than the acceptance has chargeable amendments, one further row is owed at the category's amendment fee in full, never pro rata, and it references the most recently signed amendment that no amendment-fee row references yet, so that a backlog of unsettled amendments is settled one row per amendment. When every chargeable amendment already has its row, nothing further is owed and the fee is 0.00.

## Amendment fee by category
| Category | Amendment fee (USD per chargeable amendment) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 125.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 175.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 450.00 |

## Comparison and outcome
| Amendment-fee rows already on the account, compared with chargeable amendments | Fee owed now |
|---|---|
| fewer | one further row at the category's amendment fee in full, referencing the most recently signed amendment that no amendment-fee row references yet |
| as many or more | 0.00 |

## Worked case — settling a backlog (hypothetical acceptance under AHL DG Class 9 Standard)
The acceptance has two chargeable amendments. Its signed amendments, in signing order, are A (signed 1 May), B (signed 3 May) and C (signed 6 May).

| Amendment-fee rows already on the account | Fewer than 2 | Row owed now | Amendment the row references |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | yes | 125.00 | C — the most recently signed amendment no row references |
| one, referencing C | yes | 125.00 | B — C is already referenced |
| two, referencing C and B | no | 0.00 | — |

Each row is the full 125.00, never a share of it, and the backlog is cleared one row per amendment.

## Points of judgement
- *Which amendment does a further row reference?* The most recently signed amendment that no amendment-fee row references yet.
- *Does a re-review fee on the account count as an amendment-fee row?* No; only rows charged as amendment fees are compared with the chargeable amendments.
- *Is the fee reduced when the amendment changes only a small weight?* No; the category's fee is owed in full, never pro rata.
